D_motivation.description: This dimension groups current students by their stated study motivation, sense of choice, confidence in their study field, and connection to their institution.

cluster_forming_variables.survey_question: Why are you studying right now? Which best describes your motivation?
How much choice and control do you have over what and how you study?
How capable and effective do you feel in your area of study?
How much do you feel you belong and are connected to the people at your institution?

method.clustering: Consensus ensemble of K-medoids and spectral clustering; final K-medoids on one minus co-association

D_economic.description: This dimension groups current students by their observed household economic and education-funding situation.

cluster_forming_variables.survey_question: What is the approximate total monthly income of your household from all sources?
How many people live in your household in total?
How many people in your household are currently working for a salary or wage?
How many people in your household are currently without work and actively looking for a job?
Are you the primary income earner in your household?
Currently, where does most of your money come from?
How is your current education mainly funded?

method.clustering: Consensus ensemble of K-medoids and spectral clustering; final K-medoids on one minus co-association

D_educational_cultural.description: This dimension groups current students by family education, expected education, institution type, work while studying, and education re-entry.

cluster_forming_variables.survey_question: What is the highest level of education your father completed?
What is the highest level of education your mother completed?
What is the highest level of education or training you expect to complete in total?
What type of institution are you currently attending?
Did you work (or do you currently work) while studying?
Have you ever stopped your education to work or look for work, then re-entered education later?

method.distance: Equal-weight mixed, missing-aware Gower on original responses
method.clustering: Consensus ensemble of K-medoids and spectral clustering; final K-medoids on one minus co-association

E_learning_orientation.description: This dimension groups job-seeking young people by how useful they found earlier education, their further-learning plans, and their expected education level.

cluster_forming_variables.survey_question: Do you feel that the education or training you have received is useful for getting a job?

cluster_forming_variables.variable: Plans for further education or training
cluster_forming_variables.survey_question: Do you plan to pursue further education/training?
What is the highest education you expect to complete?

method.distance: Mixed Gower on two nominal and one ordered response
method.clustering: Consensus ensemble of K-medoids and spectral clustering; final K-medoids on one minus co-association

F_employment_security.description: This dimension groups employed young people by their contract type, expected job security, and work formality.

cluster_forming_variables.survey_question: What kind of employment contract are you currently working under?

cluster_forming_variables.variable: Job security over the next 12 months
cluster_forming_variables.survey_question: How likely is it that you will be able to keep your main job over the next 12 months?
How would you describe the formality of your work situation?

method.distance: Equal-weight mixed Gower on original employment responses
method.clustering: Consensus ensemble of K-medoids and spectral clustering; final K-medoids on one minus co-association

G_economic_role.description: This dimension groups young people outside work and education by their household economic role, income source, and household work situation.

cluster_forming_variables.survey_question: What is the approximate total monthly income of your household from all sources?
How many people live in your household in total?
How many people in your household are currently working for a salary or wage?
How many people in your household are currently without work and actively looking for a job?
Are you the primary income earner in your household?
Currently, where does most of your money come from?

method.distance: Equal-weight missing-aware mixed Gower on components derived from original survey variables
method.clustering: Consensus ensemble of K-medoids and spectral clustering; final K-medoids on one minus co-association

G_future_engagement.description: This dimension groups young people outside work and education by prior work experience and their stated intentions for future work and education.

cluster_forming_variables.variable: Reason for not being in work or seeking work
cluster_forming_variables.survey_question: What is your main reason for not currently working or actively looking for work?
Have you ever worked for pay or profit at any point in your life?
Do you want to work in the future?
Do you want to continue or start education or training in the future?

method.distance: Equal-weight Gower on original nominal and binary survey responses
method.clustering: Consensus ensemble of K-medoids and spectral clustering; final K-medoids on one minus co-association
